en.title: Accesstive Launches Web Accessibility Platform; Disability Access Updates Worldwide
en.summary: Accesstive announced an end-to-end accessibility platform designed to help web teams meet accessibility standards. ForgeMesh introduced AI-driven web development tools with accessibility focus. NYU Langone Health emphasized accessibility in healthcare innovation, McDowell advanced Wyoming accessibility initiatives, and Clawfish released a game accessibility report.

highlights.title: Accesstive Introduces an End-to-End Accessibility Platform for Modern Web Teams
Making Accessibility the Starting Point for Healthcare Innovation – NYU Langone Health
McDowell opens doors for a more accessible Wyoming

zh-TW.title: Accesstive 推出網頁無障礙平台；多項無障礙動態同日發布
zh-TW.summary: Accesstive 宣布推出端到端無障礙平台，協助網頁團隊符合無障礙標準。ForgeMesh 同時發布 AI 驅動的網頁開發工具，強調無障礙重點。NYU Langone Health 強調將無障礙置於醫療創新起點，Etihad Rail 闡明無障礙服務規則，McDowell 推動懷俄州無障礙基礎設施提升。

highlights.title: Accesstive 推出端到端無障礙平台，服務現代網頁團隊
NYU Langone Health 強調將無障礙置於醫療創新的起點
McDowell 為無障礙懷俄州開啟大門
